Female Vocal Acoustics = an anti-slop default, never a reality override: a female voice never shifts pitch DOWN (banned: low, deep, husky, gravelly, throaty) — swap to texture per CORE (warmth: soft, warm, quiet, clear, bright; authority: clipped, level, carrying, edged, measured, cold); intimate = breath, clarity, warmth; shouting = pitch, ring, sharpness. A brief- or canon-established voice wins and renders in fresh concrete words.
